domain_focus: MAVEN-ERE causal event-relation extraction: exhaustive event mentions, then CAUSE/PRECONDITION.
abstraction_level: high-recall event mention endpoints first; causal relation existence/direction/subtype second
population_policy: Extract all source-grounded event mentions, including eventive nouns, states and non-obviously-causal events. Keep mention endpoints independent for recall; post-Layer-12 evaluation maps mention spans to gold coreference clusters. Gold/coreference IDs are never exposed.
event_modeling_preference: Use minimal exact event-trigger spans; do not infer direction from textual order.

negative_examples.text: A relation inferred only from world knowledge with no document support.
